messages:
marco: seeing an odd spike in controller queue depth on us-central1 after the midnight maintenance; a few nodes went read-only briefly and kube attach retries increased. infra-bot flagged CRC and queue-full events.
infra-bot: [ALERT] nvme_controller_queue_depth > 800 (us-central1) — 14m. nvme_crc_errors > 20. dashboards: /dash/nvme-queue /dash/nvme-crc. runbook: /runbooks/controller-queue.md
deep s: digging in logs - pattern shows janitor deep-scrub + node-health-check causing bursty metadata reads. controllers hit queue limits and flapped to readonly on two hosts. pending GPU pods ~33.
tara: scrub_concurrency was raised to 10 last week to catch backlog; that plus parallel health-check fsreads triggered the queues. we should immediately reduce concurrency and enable per-node scrub backoff.
marco: agree. quick mitigation ordered: 1) set JANITOR_SCRUB_CONCURRENCY=3 in infra-us-central1, 2) enable janitor backoff-on-io=true, 3) set affected nodes to transient-readonly-handling.
ops-fin: if we need to spill traffic to us-east1 for 30m, estimated cost delta ~$110/hr for routing 12% of new GPU launches. finance ok for emergency.
infra-bot: recommended commands and scope attached.
marco: applying hotpatch now (region-scoped).
```
kubectl set env deployment/janitor JANITOR_SCRUB_CONCURRENCY=3 -n infra-us-central1
kubectl set env deployment/janitor JANITOR_BACKOFF_ON_IO=true -n infra-us-central1
kubectl annotate nodes -l affected=true ops/temporary-readonly=true
```
deep s: applied. also switched image-pull cache to network-backed warm-cache for this region to move reads off local NVMe for 45m.
tara: initial effect: controller queue depth 820 -> 210 in ~6m, nvme_crc_errors falling, attach pending 33 -> 4. good.
marco: nice. follow-ups: schedule staggered scrub windows (per-AZ) and add a controller-queue SLO to catch this earlier. file RFC: /docs/rfcs/staggered-scrub-schedule.md
ops-fin: confirmed spill not needed. closing unless we see recurrence.
marco: will run a focused canary of reduced scrub concurrency across one AZ overnight and track wear/regression. retro tomorrow 09:00. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
